title: should mount on-screen panels and render a placeholder for off-screen panels
verifies: opening a large dashboard mounts near-fold panels as full containers while a far-down panel renders only a lightweight placeholder

title: should mount a placeholder panel on scroll and keep it mounted when scrolling away
verifies: scrolling a placeholder panel into view replaces it with a PanelContainer, and scrolling back away does not un-mount it (one-way)

title: should render the placeholder with the panel title but no chart or table body
verifies: the placeholder shows the panel title but renders no chart/table/no-data renderer (no async renderer chunk fetched)

title: should not fetch panel data until the placeholder panel is scrolled into view
verifies: panel data is not fetched while the panel is a placeholder, and a renderer appears only after the panel is scrolled into view
